package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var child = ResultType("application/vnd.occurrence-child", func() {
	Attributes(func() {
		Attribute("name", String)
		Attribute("detail", String)
	})
	View("default", func() {
		Attribute("name")
		Attribute("detail")
	})
	View("tiny", func() { Attribute("name") })
})
var parent = ResultType("application/vnd.occurrence-parent", func() {
	Attributes(func() {
		Attribute("full", child)
		Attribute("small", child)
	})
	View("default", func() {
		Attribute("full")
		Attribute("small", func() { View("tiny") })
	})
})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {
	Method("send", func() {
		Result(parent)
		HTTP(func() { GET("/nested") })
	})
})
